up: For assay CHEMBL3988443, return the reported activity data for all tested compounds. Output the compound ChEMBL ID, molecule name, standard type, standard relation, standard value, and standard units. Return all reported values, including those with relations other than '='.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name AS molecule_name, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3988443'
